blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes: Midas mMEV is a permissioned liquid-yield token with issuer/admin control surfaces around minting, redemption, transfer administration, and upgradeable protocol contracts.

oracleRisk.summary: mMEV is a NAV-accreting Midas Liquid Yield Token tracking a delta-neutral DeFi strategy; its underlying protocols can have liquidation risk, but mMEV is not itself a borrower CDP.

branchApplicability.rationale: Midas describes mMEV as a Liquid Yield Token for an MEV Capital-managed, delta-neutral strategy and separately identifies on-chain liquidation calls as one possible strategy activity. The reviewed product materials do not describe mMEV tokenholders opening borrower-owned debt positions or a token-level collateral threshold, liquidation engine, backstop, or shutdown branch; risks in underlying DeFi protocols are not an mMEV CDP branch to inventory under V9.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: mMEV is issued natively by Midas on Ethereum, Plume, and Etherlink. Row-level on-chain verification on 2026-07-20: each deployment is a Midas-administered transparent proxy (EIP-1967 impl/admin slots read on all three chains), no LayerZero endpoint() surface exists on any of them, and the verified mint-authority review (2026-07-13) confirms each chain mints through its own Midas deposit-vault minter holding M_MEV_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE plus Midas admin EOAs under chain-local 1-of-3 Safes. No third-party bridge carries the representation; cross-chain movement is issuer-operated.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-8 (lead usdy-ondo-finance)
